extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create or find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who are trying to create or locate a Wikipedia article with a given title; covers account requirements, search/duplication checks, capitalization/redirects, deletion logs, and timing/purge issues. Intended to help novice editors resolve why a requested page does not exist and what to do next.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the page; as alternatives, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request new article (alternative workflows)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These options are recommended for users who cannot create pages directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or prefer guided drafting and review before a page goes live.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Pilot (season 1) of Cheers" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings and look for pages within Wikipedia that already cover the topic to avoid creating duplicate content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can show whether the topic exists under a different title or whether redirects are appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation / database delay and purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes for the database to update or try the purge function to force-refresh; this resolves transient visibility issues for newly created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants of the title and, if the correct page uses a different capitalization, create a redirect rather than a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted pages: check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see "Why was the page I created deleted?"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating content, review deletion reasons in the log to understand if the topic met notability or content policies and to avoid repeating issues that led to deletion.
